title: MEGAVERSE : Benchmarking Large Language Models Across Languages, Modalities, Models and Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking LLM performance across 83 diverse languages and 22 datasets to quantify the capability gap between high-resource languages (like English) and low-resource or non-Latin script languages.

Evaluating translation accuracy on the WinoMT corpus by measuring overall gender accuracy, the F1 score difference between masculine and feminine translations, and the F1 score difference between pro-stereotypical and anti-stereotypical gender role assignments.
